summary: Fence whole-log fallback across projection chunks and preserve atomic, subject-keyed conflict degradation.

replay.detail: Automatic full-replay fallback checks the complete admitted log for operation conflicts, including conflicts beyond the current projection chunk. Unhealthy-graph and unsupported-kind replay requirements are durably deferred while bounded receipt advances; explicit repair remains required. Conflict counts are computed on health reads, not each conflicting receipt.

schema.detail: No schema changes; diagnostics continue to use projection_health.

rules.detail: Canonical operation and graph fold rules are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Conflict health entries are keyed by full operation and subject identities; display truncation never changes their durable key. Existing stale entries are not overwritten by unrelated receipts. Unsupported owned-set conflicts suppress only their own set projection.

manual.detail: A projection:deferred-replay stale health entry requires explicit repair; receipt does not run the deferred whole-log replay under its writer loan.

recovery.detail: An isolated claim failure inside a bounded refold aborts the entire refold and restores the prior aggregate before recording degradation, instead of retaining partial state.

downtime.detail: No production timing measurement is claimed.
